description.from: Local README now shows working/staged changes -> inspection before commit -> local history -> push/remote -> downstream clones/pulls. It distinguishes detected material blocked before commit from later checks after history exists, actual commit-msg timing, staged-diff limits, bypasses, overrides, HMAC trust and layered defenses. Both Mermaid diagrams parsed and rendered offline. GitBouncer branding and Data Parade positioning are being reconciled with the explicit naming decision; source publication remains pending.
description.to: Retain the verified Mermaid flow from working/staged changes through inspection before commit, local Git history, push/remote, and downstream copies. Explain early interception versus later checks, actual commit-msg timing, staged-diff limits, misses, bypasses, overrides, HMAC trust, and layered defenses. Update identity and usage for LeftBlock and https://github.com/DataParade-io/LeftBlock, preserving legacy Pudicus compatibility. Integrate the Ryan-owned logo when supplied and rerender any changed diagrams. Release/install claims must follow actual verified outcomes.
